<div style="display: flex; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 1em;">

    <rect x="20" y="170" width="260" height="80" fill="#a7d1ab" stroke="#333" stroke-width="1.5" rx="14" />

    <text x="35" y="345" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">Doc_3</text>
    <!-- Feature Matrix Table (SVG) - TOP -->

    <text x="590" y="65" font-family="Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="bold">purring</text>
    <text x="480" y="90" font-family="Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="bold">Doc_1</text>

    <text x="600" y="130" font-family="Arial" font-size="13">0.7</text>

    <text x="590" y="265" font-family="Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#228B22">Cat</text>
    <text x="660" y="265" font-family="Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#228B22">Mouse</text>

    <!-- Arrows (adjusted for new layout) -->
    <defs>
      <marker id="arrowheadorange" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="10" refY="3.5" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">
        <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="orange" />
      </marker>
    </defs>
    <defs>
      <marker id="arrowheadgreen" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="10" refY="3.5" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">

      </marker>

    <line x1="220" y1="85" x2="470" y2="90" stroke="orange" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrowheadorange)" />
    <line x1="220" y1="195" x2="470" y2="110" stroke="orange" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrowheadorange)" />
    <line x1="220" y1="305" x2="470" y2="120" stroke="orange" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrowheadorange)" />
    <line x1="220" y1="105" x2="470" y2="290" stroke="green" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrowheadgreen)" />
    <line x1="220" y1="215" x2="470" y2="310" stroke="green" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrowheadgreen)" />
    <line x1="220" y1="325" x2="470" y2="330" stroke="green" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrowheadgreen)" />
